newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: IMF to meet on Venezuela stand-by in Sept -Petkoff.
newsitem.headline: IMF to meet on Venezuela stand-by in Sept -Petkoff.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund will meet to decide on Venezuela's request for a 12-month extension of its stand-by agreement in September, Planning Minister Teodoro Petkoff said Monday.
"I understand that the IMF board will take a decision in September," Petkoff told reporters after making a presentation at a two-day conference organized by British publication The Economist.
The stand-by agreement would involve no cash disbursements Petkoff said. "For us, it brings political strength and the technical help is useful," he said.
Venezuela signed a 12-month $1.5 billion stand-by loan agreement with the IMF last July.
Under the agreement, Venezuela dropped price and exchange controls and hiked gasoline prices.
A sharp increase in revenues thanks to high oil prices saw Venezuela cancel most of the IMF loan after receiving the first $500 million.
